verdict.rationale: Bento captures every span over OpenTelemetry and shows them as a span tree (bentolabs-docs-3), with manual `bento.track_ai` wrapping for uninstrumented calls (bentolabs-docs-18). Runs are grouped through `session_id` set on every span (bentolabs-docs-23) and a shared `convo_id` that ties runs into conversations (bentolabs-docs-24). Missing for 10: detailed docs on parent/child span nesting for multi-step agent runs beyond a 'span tree' mention, documentation of a session/thread view in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
